balance.trait.balanced: Balanced attributes and versatile growth; no dominant specialization.
balance.trait.guardian: More health and resistance. Technique reduces the next incoming hit by 35%; slower attacks.
balance.trait.duelist: Fast, strong physical attacks; low health, ninjutsu and chakra reserves.
balance.trait.skirmisher: Higher attack and movement speed; lower health and resistance.
balance.trait.caster: Techniques scale strongly with ninjutsu. High chakra, but weak basic attacks and little protection.
balance.trait.medic: Technique restores health and scales with ninjutsu. Good chakra regeneration, lower damage and speed.
balance.trait.tactician: Technique costs 28 chakra. Good control and ninjutsu, with moderate health and strength.
balance.trait.bruiser: Higher strength and health, powerful physical technique; lower speed and little chakra.
balance.authoredTechnique: Technique authored for this idle, shown with a validated basic attack; not a recovered original jutsu.

balance.enemyHint.brute: More health and slow, heavy blows. Little ninjutsu resistance.
balance.enemyHint.assassin: Fast attacks. The third strike bypasses part of your resistance.
balance.enemyHint.armored: Resists physical damage; ninjutsu techniques are more effective.
balance.enemyHint.caster: Tries to keep distance and resists ninjutsu; more vulnerable to physical attacks.
balance.enemyHint.medic: Tries to keep distance. Every third action can heal 8% of maximum health instead of attacking, up to three times per encounter.
balance.enemyHint.balanced: Patrols the area with balanced attributes.
balance.eliteHint: Elite: more health, damage and resistance; 2.5× same-type rewards and a 25% chance of unowned equipment, limited by level and difficulty.
